grammarName.en: Prepositions of place · there is/are · this/that

scenario: Over the weekend Kate rearranges the whole office for 'good energy'. On Monday nobody can find anything, so the episode is full of prepositions of place, 'there is/are', and this/that/these/those. Den's mug is now on a high shelf, behind a plant; his chair is by the door, not at his desk. Kate says, 'There is a new sofa near the window. These boxes are yours, those are mine. Your keyboard is under the plant.' Den is upset ('My mug was on my desk!'). Pol loves the new plant corner between the sofa and the window. Alex jokes that his new desk is a great place for a nap. Warm chaos, gentle humour. Use lots of prepositions (on, in, under, behind, next to, near, between), 'there is/there are', and this/that/these/those. Short A2 sentences.
